# Ezekiel 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The LORD spoke to me again:

**2** "Son of man, turn and face the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them.

**3** Say to them: 'Mountains of Israel, listen to the message of the Lord GOD!' The Lord GOD says to the mountains, hills, ravines, and valleys: I am about to bring war against you and destroy your pagan shrines.

**4** Your altars will be smashed, your incense altars shattered, and I will throw your dead bodies down in front of your idols.

**5** I will pile the corpses of the Israelites in front of their idols and scatter their bones around their altars.

**6** Wherever you live, your cities will be demolished and your hilltop shrines torn down. Your altars will be wrecked, your idols smashed, your incense altars chopped down, and everything you've made will be obliterated.

**7** Bodies will be piled up among you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

**8** But I will spare some of you. Some will escape the slaughter and be scattered among the nations.

**9** Those survivors, living in exile, will remember Me. They will finally understand how their unfaithful hearts and their wandering eyes — always chasing after idols — broke My heart. They will be disgusted with themselves for all the evil and detestable things they did.

**10** And they will know that I am the LORD. My threats were never empty."

**11** The Lord GOD says: "Clap your hands, stomp your feet, and cry out in grief over all the disgusting sins of Israel — because they are going to die by sword, famine, and disease.

**12** Those far away will die of plague. Those nearby will fall by the sword. Those who survive the siege will starve. I will pour out all My fury on them.

**13** You will know that I am the LORD when their dead lie among their idols — around their altars, on every high hill and mountaintop, under every green tree and leafy oak — everywhere they burned sweet incense to their idols.

**14** I will stretch out My hand and turn their land into a desolate wasteland, from the southern desert all the way to Riblah. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **6:3**: God tells Ezekiel to preach to mountains. Not people — mountains. Because the mountains have been hosting pagan worship for centuries. Even the landscape has become corrupt.

- **6:9**: One of the most tender verses in Ezekiel — God says His heart was 'broken' by their unfaithfulness. This isn't cold anger. This is the grief of a betrayed lover.

- **6:8-10**: Even in the middle of devastating judgment, God plants a seed of hope — some will survive, remember, and be genuinely disgusted with what they did. Repentance starts with honest self-awareness.

— PNEUMA
